title: R. Ḥurūf ('On the Letters')
transliterated_title: Ḥurūf (var. R. Ḥarfiyya; R. Ḥarf; R. Jāmiʿ-i Aṭvār-i ʿIlm-i Ḥurūf)

date.basis: MK: 'completed on' this date in Shiraz; differs from the earliest surviving copy (Majlis 10196, Yazd, 14 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/27 Sept 1425), so it is not the copy date; MK does not name the source of the 817 date. Tension: the work is said to mention the Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam, dated Dhū l-Ḥijja 817/March 1415, which is later than 10 Ramaḍān 817 (unreconciled in the entry).

place: Shiraz (composition, per MK); the Majlis 10196 copy was made in Yazd
addressee: A dignitary, 'perhaps Iskandar Mīrzā' (MK); a copy went to Sayyid Niẓām al-Dīn Aḥmad with letter 15
occasion: Written at a dignitary's request, shortly after (per MK's footnote) Iskandar's rebellion against Shāhrukh was violently quashed.
manuscript: 18 copies listed; earliest dated: MS 15/5 Ankara (833/1429) and MS Majlis 10196 ff. 154b-57b (Yazd, 14 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/27 Sept 1425, the earliest surviving copy per MK); then MS 5423 (842/1439), BL Add. 23983 (858/1454), and later copies.
summary: A summary, introductory treatment of the premises of the science of letters in three aṣls (written, spoken and mental-spiritual form of the letters), aimed at the theoretical lettrists (ahl-i ḥaqāyiq); MK edits and translates it in Part 2 (§T.2).
